Name: Perma-Fluffy Sheep
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
I prefer the fluffy look of the un-sheared sheep, so I usually manually replace the sheared sprites with their un-sheared versions. This is just a quick mod to make that manual replacement unnecessary!

[list]
[*]For Stardew 1.6 only
[*]Requires Content Patcher
[*]Compatible with CP or AT mods that replace the [b]default[/b] sheep sprites
[*]Compatible with [b]Farm Animal Facelift (Skins Version)[/b]. If you use Farm Animal Facelift (either of the CP versions) but don't use all available skins for sheep, you may see some warning messages in your SMAPI console that begin "[Content Patcher] Can't apply data patch ..." These messages are harmless, but you can get rid of them by opening the Perma-Fluffy Sheep config menu in GMCM and disabling any unused skins.
[/list]
[b]NOTE:[/b] If you're worried about not having a visual indicator of whether the sheep is ready to be sheared, you can either use an Auto-Grabber or install a mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/859]Better Ranching[/url] or [url=https://github.com/Annosz/UIInfoSuite2/releases]UI Info Suite 2[/url].
